topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer opens the session by connecting histopathology practicals to cellular changes and outlining the lecture's learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor viruses and cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: They trace how the investigation of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular oncogenes and established laboratory assays for measuring cell transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: They define the functional categories of oncogenes and tumor suppressors and illustrate their molecular consequences using cell-cycle and p53 models.

topics.label: Mechanisms of genetic instability and tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: They explain the molecular defects causing sequence and chromosomal instability and show how this instability accelerates stepwise tumor development.

topics.label: Hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how inherited germline mutations predispose individuals to malignancy and shape subsequent tumor evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation by reviewing learning outcomes, inviting questions, and recommending supplementary reading.
